title: Cosme Kitchen Organic Argan Oil 30ml
description_en: Cold-pressed, ECOCERT-certified organic argan oil — one application nourishes face, hair, cuticles, and body. Rich in vitamin E and essential fatty acids. The 'liquid gold' of Morocco, curated for Japan's natural beauty market.
description_ja: EKO認証の有機アルガンオイル。コールドプレス製法で栄養素をそのまま凝縮。顔・髪・ボディ・爪まで全身に使えるマルチオイル。ビタミンEと必須脂肪酸が豊富な'液体ゴールド'。
